summary: Buon Ma Thuot is the robusta capital: a phin in the morning, then the highland towns that grow the cup.
body: Vietnamese coffee is usually robusta, brewed in a small metal phin. Ca phe sua da is iced coffee with condensed milk. Egg coffee, ca phe trung, is a Hanoi whipped-egg cup. Wait for the phin to finish, then stir.

Buon Ma Thuot flies into BMV. The town has coffee houses and a biennial March festival on October 10 Square. Da Lat’s cup belongs to the hills around Cau Dat. Hanoi is where you sit down for egg coffee. Pleiku’s Biển Hồ slopes, about 12 km north of town, are tea, not a coffee field.
